name: ConsultBae Candidate Ingestion, Deduplication & LLM Skill Classifier

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM candidates WHERE (phone = '{{ $json.phone }}' AND '{{ $json.phone }}' != '') OR (email = '{{ $json.email }}' AND '{{ $json.email }}' != '') LIMIT 1;

parameter.name: message
parameter.value: =Duplicate Candidate Alert: {{ $('Data Normalizer').item.json.raw_name }} already exists in system with status {{ $json.status }}.

parameters.text:
=You are an expert technical talent recruiter at ConsultBae.
Analyze the following candidate skills and metadata:
Name: {{ $('Data Normalizer').item.json.raw_name }}
Experience: {{ $('Data Normalizer').item.json.experience_years }} years
Skills: {{ $('Data Normalizer').item.json.skills }}

Tasks:
1. Classify candidate into exactly ONE primary category: ["Automation Specialist", "Full-Stack Web Dev", "Data & AI Engineer", "Backend Engineer"].
2. Assign Seniority Level: ["Junior", "Mid-Level", "Senior", "Lead"].
3. Output a 1-sentence recruitment summary.

Respond strictly in valid JSON with keys: category, seniority, recruitment_summary.

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO candidates (
  full_name, email, phone, city, experience_years, status, skills, data_sources, updated_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $('Data Normalizer').item.json.raw_name }}',
  '{{ $('Data Normalizer').item.json.email }}',
  '{{ $('Data Normalizer').item.json.phone }}',
  '{{ $('Data Normalizer').item.json.city }}',
  {{ $('Data Normalizer').item.json.experience_years }},
  'Active',
  '{{ $('Data Normalizer').item.json.skills }}',
  'n8n-webhook-intake',
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
